Meta Ads

Connect campaign creative with qualified customer outcomes.

MAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Meta Ads supports campaign delivery across eligible Meta placements, with audience, creative, and reporting capabilities. MoreSpace can structure a measurable acquisition funnel that links reviewed campaign ideas, appropriate audiences, landing experiences, and CRM qualification rather than judging results solely by platform clicks.

Useful outputs

  • Structured campaigns with clear naming and controlled budgets
  • Qualified enquiry handoffs and event measurement configuration
  • Creative, acquisition-cost, and pipeline outcome scorecards

Where we can apply it

  • Reviewed offer → Canva creative → Meta campaign → landing page enquiry.
  • Lead event → eligibility and field checks → CRM owner → qualification outcome.
  • Campaign spend → CRM pipeline → attributed revenue review → acquisition scorecard.
01

Use case 1

Build acquisition campaigns aligned with a defined offer and target market.

02

Use case 2

Connect eligible lead enquiries with CRM ownership and qualification.

03

Use case 3

Compare creative and audience performance with downstream sales outcomes.

Inputs we need

  • Approved offer, audience definitions, and advertising budget
  • Reviewed creative assets and landing-page destinations
  • Consent-aware event plan, lead fields, and CRM qualification criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Map the offer, customer journey, campaign objective, and conversion definition.
  • Configure reviewed creative and measurement, then test lead and event handoffs.
  • Launch within approved budgets and review qualified outcomes with sales.

Expert review points

  • Approve claims, creative, target markets, and spend before campaign launch.
  • Review consent, attribution windows, and event deduplication before reporting revenue.
